visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a long-sleeved black shirt and black pants stands in an indoor room with wooden cabinetry and glass doors. He gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while standing next to a large white suitcase with beige trim and a telescopic handle. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the suitcase front panel. The man's hands are visible as he unzips and flips down a half-section of the front cover to reveal neatly packed items inside, including clothes, a leather wallet, and headphones. Yellow captions appear at the bottom. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor sidewalk where the man walks with a grey version of the suitcase. He demonstrates a locking mechanism on the side and uses his foot to show the wheel brake function. Trees, a green fence, and passing yellow taxis are visible in the background. (4) A rapid montage follows, showing the suitcase in various settings: inside a car trunk, being dropped in a testing facility, and spinning inside a large industrial drum. The testing footage is presented in high contrast, highlighting the physical impact on the suitcase body and wheels. (5) Back indoors, the man sits next to an open suitcase that has internal dividers resembling refrigerator shelves. He points to organized compartments filled with clothing and accessories. Finally, he stands again with multiple suitcases in different colors (white, grey, green) and gives a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a male voice speaking in a cheerful, well-enunciated professional tone. Simultaneously, an upbeat background music track featuring acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat begins. There is high speech density with minimal pauses. (2) As the speaker demonstrates the suitcase, a series of crisp 'clicks' and mechanical latching sounds are heard, punctuating the dialogue. These incidental noises indicate high signal clarity. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies several fast visual transitions between shots. (3) During the durability test sequence, heavy rhythmic thumping and percussive impact sounds occur as the suitcase hits surfaces. The background music remains continuous, maintaining a constant tempo of 118 BPM, which keeps the energy level high. (4) In the outdoor segment, faint urban ambient noise, such as distant vehicle tires on asphalt, is audible but clearly ducked beneath the primary voice and music track. The speaker's pitch remains varied and dynamic throughout the presentation. (5) The video concludes with the speaker delivering a call to action. A final digital 'ping' sound effect marks the appearance of the discount code on screen. The music and voice end abruptly together with a final hard cut.

It uses a high-energy presenter to demonstrate practical features like the front-opening panel and wheel brakes while providing objective proof of durability through industrial testing to convince viewers to use the provided discount code.
